notes.en: Static content review only. SKILL.md and bundled scripts reviewed against the manifest: declared capabilities browser.observe/browser.interact/execution.remote/workspace.read/workspace.write and required tool exec.shell match shipped content; the browser is driven only by the compiled native browser.* tools (no Playwright/CDP, intentionally absent); the fixture server binds loopback by default and binds every interface only under the Floe service supervisor (FLOE_SERVICE_PORT), which forwards host-side to 127.0.0.1; Python in the guest never operates the browser. No self-granted trust, no unlisted-skill fetch, no install-time privilege. Guest execution remains UNPROVEN (Main-owned); this is not runtime qualification or App acceptance.
notes.zh-Hans: 仅静态内容审核。已按清单核对 SKILL.md 与随附脚本：声明能力 browser.observe/browser.interact/execution.remote/workspace.read/workspace.write 与必需工具 exec.shell 和实际内容一致；浏览器仅由编译原生 browser.* 工具驱动（无 Playwright/CDP，属有意缺失）；夹具服务器默认绑定回环，仅在 Floe 服务监管（FLOE_SERVICE_PORT）下才绑定所有接口，宿主侧仅转发到 127.0.0.1；来宾内 Python 永不操作浏览器。无自我授权信任、无拉取未列名 Skill、无安装时特权。来宾执行仍为未证实（Main 负责）；此非运行时鉴定或 App 验收。
